text.p: Philippine Realty and Holdings Corp (Philrealty) executive vice president Amador Bacani on Wednesday rejected rumours the company was the target of a buy in.

"I don't know about that ... We don't have plans to issue more shares," Bacani told Reuters when asked about stock market rumours that Philex Mining and DMCI Holdings Inc were buying into the company.

Philrealty has been on a steady uptrend since last month, gaining 74.54 percent since October 29 when it was at 1.10 pesos. It reached its record high of 1.92 pesos on Tuesday and retreated only slightly to close at 1.90 pesos on Wednesday.
Bacani said Philex Mining has a stake in the company since mid-1980s. Its stake was reduced when it did not subscribe to the rights offer in December 1994.
As for DMCI, whose president Isidro Consunji was recently appointed as a director of Philrealty, "As far as I know, he has not bought any shares," Bacani added.
Officials from both Philex and DMCI were not immediately available for comment.
Bacani said the renewed interest in the company might be due to the recent sale of its shares in Philippine Racing Club worth 1.98 billion pesos to liquidate debt and finance real estate projects.
